NewsArticle.Title: Political Office
NewsArticle.Content:
At Aislings request, all Aislings born on today or after must live in Temuair for 1 Temuairan year before taking office. Respected Citizen is not an office, although it is a prerequisite to many offices. So one may become respected citizen during their Aisling birth year.
All Aislings born yesterday or before are unaffected.
